rationale: TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners is one qualifying U.S. digital-infrastructure platform. Direct company, manager and regulatory evidence corrects the published sole-UIF view to three evidenced current institutional owners: Meritage, Ullico/UIF and Munich Re through MEAG/MR Highland LP, with the latter holding 15.0%. TowerPoint Capital is evidenced as manager, not as a countable owner.

repoReconciliation.preserveBoundary: one TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners platform; keep TowerPoint Capital, affiliates, towers, leases and financing SPVs beneath or outside the PortCo boundary as appropriate

proposalGuardrails: Replace the sole-UIF ownership view with the three evidenced institutional owners; do not infer undisclosed Meritage or UIF percentages.
Record Munich Re's 15.0% through MR Highland LP with MEAG as manager and do not convert the 2026 securitization into ownership.
Do not add TowerPoint Capital as an owner; public sources call it the manager and disclose no material stake.
Treat any small management participation as not publicly disclosed and noncountable unless later direct evidence establishes it.
Use December 2024 for the recap closing period and by September 30, 2025 for Munich Re's entry; retain exact days as unavailable.
Do not create towers, leases, TowerPoint affiliates or MTP ABS Funding as separate PortCos.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Meritage and UIF exact stakes and deal vehicles
Exact recap and Munich Re closing days
recommendedNextAction: Prepare one later protected correction proposal for TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners, preserving one canonical company and adding the complete evidenced owner roster without inferring undisclosed stakes.
